description.before: Indoor autonomous security robot from Knightscope's ASR family, designed for structured indoor patrol and deterrence in offices, lobbies and venues.
description.after: K3 is the indoor autonomous security robot documented in Knightscope’s 2023 Form 10-K. The filing lists approximately 340 lb, 4 ft height and 2 ft width, with geofenced navigation using lasers, ultrasonic sensors, an IMU and wheel encoders. Its K3/K5 family statement gives roughly 2–3 hours patrol and charging stops of about 20 minutes or more. K3 disables the parking-utilization, parking-meter and plate-recognition functions described for K5. Current availability and first-release year remain unestablished.

description.before: American autonomous outdoor security robot patrolling properties around the clock.
description.after: K5 is an autonomous security patrol robot currently offered for structured outdoor locations. The linked K5 V5 brochure specifies 420 lb, 64.6 in height, 44.6 in length, 34.9 in width and up to 3 mph. Average patrol intervals of 2.5–3 hours and 20–30 minute autonomous charging stops are separate from 24/7 monitoring service. Four video cameras, thermal imaging, six LiDAR and thirteen sonar sensors support patrol and alerts. Older K5 dimensions/mass in the 2023 filing describe a different historical specification.
